purpose: P1 paired overhead rerun with Tencent-supported pretrained transfer and a useful training budget
notes: Batch 1 is the largest fixed batch that completed FP32 MOE, MOT and LATENT on this 6 GB RTX 3060 Laptop GPU.
Each on/off pair starts from the same transferred state and sees identical batches.
Validation and checkpoint writes stay outside the timed P1 overhead loop.
FP32 is required for the causal overhead comparison because AMP near-tie sparse routing diverged after batch 8 when hook synchronization changed kernel timing; that failed run is retained locally.
Sampling every 8 batches keeps five snapshots per 10-epoch COCO8 run while respecting the P1 slowdown budget; every-2 sampling exceeded the threshold for MOE at batch 1.

CUDA MOT off/off repeatability auditing showed 2.33% mean and 12.23% maximum relative loss drift despite identical initial weights and batches; GPU runs therefore publish drift instead of claiming bitwise causality.
